content.short: Tangocrypto is a leading Cardano IaaS provider offering high-availability APIs and NFT studio tools.
content.description: Tangocrypto is a premier Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS) provider dedicated to the Cardano blockchain. The platform empowers developers by providing high-availability APIs, robust SDKs, and no-code solutions like their NFT Studio. Key features include real-time webhooks for blockchain notifications, data streaming, and a specialized Query Composer for complex on-chain data retrieval. By eliminating the need for developers to manage their own nodes, Tangocrypto significantly reduces the time and cost required to build, launch, and scale decentralized applications on Cardano.
